preceding_measurements.reason: Per-object durability barriers regressed generated-build timings; replaced with bounded write batches before publication. Original results retained.

intermediate_batch_measurements.reason: Batching reduced fresh-generation overhead but repeatedly synced existing objects; a durable owner-read-only seal avoids these repeated barriers.

retained_failures.resolution: Timestamp barrier now observes known workload outputs instead of optional cache aliases.
Cancellation fixture now orders its failure after an explicit startup prerequisite; normal and sanitizer rechecks pass.
Seal immutable object metadata before recording regeneration identities; this preserves recursive-import no-op behavior.

Unprivileged corruption fixtures explicitly make sealed objects writable before fault injection; corrected syntax and all 45 runtime / 187 correctness cases pass in final-runtime-normal-corrected.log.
Optional find-unit LeakSanitizer tracer failure. Isolated retry passed in leak-check-retry.log; whole-program leak detection is not claimed.

boundaries: Cloud synthetic timings do not establish real-project performance or memory parity.
ASan/UBSan integration gates use detect_leaks=0; session lifetime tests use detect_leaks=1.
Memory samples measure wait4 peak individual-process RSS, not aggregate concurrent tree RSS.
Shared immutable objects and recursive imports are retained for saved/raw Ninja graphs; only generation bundles are collected automatically.
Persistent resolution caches pure implicit-chain feasibility, not a mutable evaluator or complete resolved graphs.
No third-party release sources were patched and no NAS was accessed.

pc_qualification.gate: Every timing and memory cell: median ratio <= 1.00 and bootstrap 95% upper ratio <= 1.05, complete correctness/artifact/source checks.
